name: imgpreview-dropzone
blurb: Multi-image dropzone with thumbnail previews in a row.
description: Drag-and-drop image uploader supporting up to 4 files (1MB max each). Shows thumbnails inline; supports SVG, PNG, JPG, GIF.
use_when: Photo gallery uploads, batch image selection with preview.
a11y: FileUploaderItem includes aria-roledescription for each file. Drop area keyboard accessible.
